stories.title: Wetzel: It's now or never for Steve Sarkisian and Arch Manning
stories.summary: Sarkisian and Manning were supposed to be a match made in heaven for Texas football. Instead, the Longhorns are surrounded by questions.

stories.title: Can Week 8 in CFB up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
stories.summary: For two decades, the SEC represented sanity, order and clarity. Now, chaos reigns.

stories.title: Two steps too many: Refs confirm LaMelo traveled en route to 3-point make
stories.summary: The association that represents NBA referees confirmed that LaMelo Ball took two steps too many and traveled in a widely seen clip from Wednesday night's win over Miami.

stories.title: Benzinger, member of Reds' 1990 World Series championship team, dies at 63
stories.summary: Todd Benzinger, a member of the Reds' 1990 World Series championship team, has died. He was 63.

stories.title: Steelers fan event at Bastille bar canceled amid civil unrest in Paris
stories.summary: A weekend event for Steelers fans in Paris has been canceled because of security concerns following recent street protests in the French capital.
